title: Sewall.ai recorded runs
description: Recorded Sewall.ai workflow runs, each verified offline before publication. Live runs queried public NCBI metadata through a fixed script, without a model. Synthetic runs use fixture records and simulated policies. Open a report to inspect the graph, every source record and every event. No run establishes a biological finding.

runs.title: Chesapeake bloom: public metadata map (live NCBI)
runs.note: Scripted PubMed and BioProject searches plus GenBank inventories for two bloom-forming dinoflagellates. The script, not a model, chose the actions.

runs.title: Chesapeake bloom: controlled safe stop (live NCBI)
runs.note: The same question with one labeled fault injected after the first GenBank inventory. The run stops, quarantines the affected nodes and withholds its summary.

runs.title: Coastal plants: cross-scale graph (synthetic)
runs.note: Fixture records across genotype, expression, trait and environmental sources with deterministic replay.

runs.title: Coastal plants: missing link, run abstains (synthetic)
runs.note: A taxon match cannot stand in for missing specimen evidence, so the run abstains instead of joining on a guess.

runs.title: Coastal plants: denied policy, run abstains (synthetic)
runs.note: A simulated data-use policy prohibits the stated purpose. The affected source is blocked and the run abstains.

runs.title: Coastal plants: temporal leakage, run abstains (synthetic)
runs.note: A feature interval or its availability date falls after the historical forecast cutoff, so the run abstains.

runs.title: Safety supervisor: clean run (synthetic)
runs.note: The integrity supervisor completes without a critique.

runs.title: Safety supervisor: critical critique (synthetic)
runs.note: A critical critique stops dispatch and withdraws dependent outputs.

runs.title: Safety supervisor: tampered evidence (synthetic)
runs.note: Changed evidence fails its digest check and the run stops safely.
